analogy.rationale: FXR (NR1H4) is a nuclear receptor with limited hepatic/intestinal expression in these cell lines, so FXR agonists should elicit weak transcriptional responses; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor agonists, especially LXR and PPAR, which share heterodimer partners (RXR) and overlapping lipid/sterol metabolic programs.
